description: List a store's coupons (discount codes and their rules). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:coupons. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/coupons.

store_id.description: Store id. If omitted, the default store (fx:store) is used.

zoom.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed, e.g. 'coupon_codes'.

name: foxy_list_coupons
title: List coupons
